subject: Geopolitics
title: Oil Price Wars
description: A quick, practical guide to Oil Price Wars.

hook.text: In 2020, Saudi Arabia flooded the market with cheap oil to punish Russia for refusing to cut production.

buildup.text: Oil price wars happen when producers compete for market share by oversupplying. Everyone bleeds revenue.

discovery.text: Low prices bankrupt high-cost producers like shale drillers and oil sands operators. The cheapest producer survives.

twist.text: Price wars also devastate oil-dependent economies. Nigeria, Venezuela, and Angola spiral into crisis when revenue drops.

climax.text: Oil price wars are a game of who can endure the most pain. The answer is usually not the poorest nation.

punchline.text: Flood the market and watch rivals drown.

quiz.question: Who suffers most from oil price wars?
